scheme_name: Hostel Facility for Students Availing Education in Delhi
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh
Applicant must be a regular student currently enrolled or admitted to an undergraduate (first year) or higher class, or professional course at a government or recognized institution located in Delhi
benefits_summary: Monthly rent assistance of ₹1,000, scholarship of ₹500, water and electricity allowance of ₹100, and a one‑time grant of ₹2,000 are provided to eligible students.
